rollback.command: Promote the previous stable deployment, freeze rollout promotion, and keep AUTH_DEGRADED_MODE_ENABLED=true during auth incidents.

stages.name: 10-percent
entryCriteria: Required alert policies are installed and paging owners are assigned.
exitCriteria: Redis and database saturation remain within budget.
Presence service joins and worker-plane ingress remain healthy.
No page-severity alert fires during the soak window.

stages.name: 50-percent
entryCriteria: Auth, hub, workspace, and messages remain stable.
Credential rollback owner is on call.
exitCriteria: Worker-plane traffic remains isolated from shell latency.
No unresolved auth callback, webhook signature, or API error alert remains open.

stages.name: 100-percent
entryCriteria: Credential rotation and rollback runbook has been reviewed for this release.
exitCriteria: Release evidence links are attached to the rollout record.

notes: This file is a rollout control plan, not proof of production approval.
Keep status pending until release, load, capacity, E2E, and alert evidence are present.
Do not mark a stage approved without an on-call owner and rollback path.
